title: Product Manager, Checkout
logged: Synthetic demo JD. Expected values were set from the first run of the tool on 2026-11 after a plausibility check (not a real historical judgment). Strong fit: checkout PM, every must-have is on the general base.
lines: You will own the checkout experience for our e-commerce marketplace and work with engineering, design and analytics.
- Own the product roadmap for checkout and write PRDs with clear acceptance criteria.
- Run product discovery and customer interviews to find the causes of drop-off.
- Design and analyse A/B tests to improve conversion.

- Strong SQL and data analysis skills.
- Experience with experimentation and A/B testing.
